methodology: Five shuffled rounds per artifact, 11 samples per run; median of run medians.  Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core, chosen again before each attempt once its other hyperthread has settled, and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
